title: SpireLab — 魔女 / The Witch
description:
[h1]魔女 / The Witch[/h1]
一名以魔法启迪临时改写手牌、在真实生命与镜像生命之间周旋的原创角色。91 种卡牌、9 件遗物、3 种药水，含简体中文与英文。

An original playable character with an Enlightenment hand-swap passive, mirror life, and five Desire cards. Includes 91 cards, 9 relics, 3 potions, and English and Simplified Chinese support.

[b]Requires BaseLib 3.4.8 or later.[/b] Tested locally on Slay the Spire 2 v0.111.1 for Apple Silicon macOS.
changeNote: v1.1.0 · Black-and-ivory Gothic visual update. New character art, cards, icons, animations and combat feedback. The Witch's card rules and IDs retain the v1.0 baseline.
